text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Flight-senpai! Thanks for taking me to 
that hero show the other day!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it was fun coming up with an 
outfit coordination you wouldn't usually 
see.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The costumes you designed— both the hero 
and the villain looked super cool, and 
everyone said they were so easy to move 
in!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heroes are wonderful, aren't they...? 
Heroes mean justice, and justice means the 
Class Rep!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case...! Why don't you 
upperclassmen star in our show next time? 
As heroes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Both of you are so cool and have 
such strong convictions, I think you'd 
make great heroes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you two are always pushing each 
other to improve, right? So I'm sure you'd 
make a passionate hero duo, joining hands 
to fight evil...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh. But Flight-san and I are rivals 
competing against each other, not a team 
joining hands. Therefore...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall stand in your way as the 
Ultra-Justice Committee Head, with a 
justice even greater than Flight-san's 
justice!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Then for me, how about— 'Super 
Fashionable Leader of Justice'... or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Super Justice Committee Head vs. Super 
Justice Fashion Leader!? You mean it's a 
battle of justice versus justice...!? 
Th-That sounds pretty interesting in its 
own way!!
